verdict.rationale: Polar documents a fully isolated sandbox environment (separate server, unlimited test accounts/orgs) that mirrors the complete customer funnel including checkout, with support for Stripe's standard test card numbers (e.g., 4242 4242 4242 4242) to simulate payment scenarios. Combined with documented failed-payment/dunning flows and refund handling, this covers most of the story's dev-experience needs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of dedicated test cards for disputes/chargebacks specifically, and independent/hands-on developer corroboration beyond vendor docs.
